snippet.title: The Starter Pokémon Arrive! | Pokémon Café Remix |Offiical Trailer
snippet.description:
To celebrate 30 years of Pokémon, the first partner Pokémon will appear in special outfits in Pokémon Café ReMix!

You can receive the partner Pokémon from the Kanto region first! Get all of their outfits through logging in, bingo, and more to liven up the café!

Check in-game for more details!
